query: Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A), and Item 8 Financial Statements and Supplementary Data sections specifically covering "Income Taxes" and "Commitments and Contingencies".

extraction.tax_contingency_note: As of September 28, 2019, the total amount of gross unrecognized tax benefits was $15.6 billion, of which $8.6 billion would impact the effective tax rate if recognized. Management believes it is reasonably possible that gross unrecognized tax benefits could decrease in the next 12 months by as much as $2.0 billion. Additionally, the Company funded an adjusted recovery amount of €12.9 billion plus interest of €1.2 billion into escrow related to the European Commission State Aid Decision, pending appeals.
